query: Based only on these records, does this user's history explain why helping paint the stairwell ceiling Tuesday afternoon would leave them unprepared for Wednesday's rotator cuff ultrasound?

ev_B.fact: I have a Wednesday morning rotator cuff ultrasound where the technician needs me to lift my arm smoothly overhead on command.
